name: contract-recorded-cases
goal: Normal verification retains hashed per-case observations and rejects missing or malformed execution coverage

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: CheckRunService retains aggregate runner status and browser diagnostics but discards per-case outcomes. A process exit alone does not prove registered cases ran.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Strengthen existing success/failure CheckRunService.run fixture cases to retain exact case observations, revision and immutable raw evidence hash; preserve all four existing cases and diagnostics boundaries.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Atc49390a16c the unchanged four-case CheckRunService suite fails the missing cases assertion. Immutable checkpoint retained in contract-recorded-cases; earlier resource-wait setup failure is not counted as defect proof.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: CheckRunService now parses strict case observations, retains the original evidence bytes and hash, refuses malformed data and discards timed-out observations. Record sealing, attachment manifests, hash checks and history projection retain these results; assembly compares observed cases with registered selected cases. Focused ten tests and TypeScript pass; broad verification remains pending.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
